summary: Verified /exportacao end-to-end after CSV bug fix. Backend (pytest, 4/4) and Frontend (Playwright) tests all pass. Export of all 4 entities in CSV now returns HTTP 200 + application/zip (was HTTP 500 due to DictWriter using only first record's keys). Single-entity CSV export returns 200 text/csv with union of all columns; JSON export returns 200 application/json. Frontend shows success toast and triggers Blob download for all three scenarios. Empty-selection validation still shows 'Selecione pelo menos uma entidade para exportar'. Resumo shows counts 6/6/8/10 as expected.

ui_bugs.issue: The prop data-testid="btn-exportar" passed to <Button> is silently dropped because Button.js only accepts a `testId` prop and does not spread ...rest onto the underlying <button>. As a result the export button has no data-testid attribute in the DOM (verified: querySelector('[data-testid=\"btn-exportar\"]') returns null). Tests must fall back to text/role selectors. Recommend either (a) forward `data-testid` in Button.js (spread rest props or read data-testid explicitly), or (b) change Exportacao.js to pass `testId="btn-exportar"` instead of `data-testid="btn-exportar"`.

action_items: Fix testId forwarding on Button component (or change Exportacao.js to use `testId` prop) so btn-exportar is discoverable via data-testid selector.
critical_code_review_comments: exportacao.py: _registros_para_csv_bytes correctly builds fieldnames as UNION of all record keys, serializes dict/list to JSON, and normalizes None -> empty string. Uses extrasaction='ignore' as safety net. Good fix.
exportacao.py: date_filter is applied to created_at only for emprestimos/pagamentos; clientes/parcelas ignore date filters silently — consider documenting or applying consistently.

Button.js: Component does not forward unknown props (no ...rest spread), so any data-* / aria-* passed via JSX is silently dropped. This will affect other pages relying on data-testid — worth an audit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend export bug (CSV DictWriter heterogeneous keys -> 500) is fixed and covered by /app/backend/tests/test_exportacao.py. Frontend flow verified via Playwright downloads. Remaining minor issue: Button component drops data-testid attribute — use role/text selectors or update Button.js to spread rest props.
rca of the issue: Original bug: routes/exportacao.py used csv.DictWriter(fieldnames=registros[0].keys()) with heterogeneous Mongo documents. When later records had keys not present in registros[0], DictWriter.writerow raised ValueError -> 500. Fix builds fieldnames as ordered union of all keys across all records and JSON-encodes nested dict/list values. Verified by pytest (test_export_csv_zip_all now returns 200) and by UI Playwright (ZIP downloaded successfully with all 4 entities).
